status: Partial source: shared navigation/panels, field, native-form button, typed selects and checkbox with four real bindings each. Checkbox and text-only dashboard tab baselines are calibrated; navigation icons/overflow, other visual calibration and full delivery/application acceptance remain required.
implemented: Shared controlled navigation/panels, text field, native-form button, typed single/multiple select and boolean checkbox; immutable DOM-free contracts, explicit registration, typed cancelable intent and one renderer per family.

Real React/Vue/Angular/Svelte bindings for all five current families. Angular includes actual field/select/checkbox Forms bridges. Runtime adapter imports stay within pure contracts and the selected framework; no alternate visuals.

792 passing Node/Chromium, architecture, CI, component/binding, lifecycle and Storybook tests. All 48 authored runtime modules are independently inventoried, including three zero-executable modules; all four metrics are 100% globally and per file.
Strict source and consumer-tool types plus Svelte package/test-fixture checks; no library checks skipped. Angular APF and Svelte declarations built by official package tools.
All five unpublished coordinates independently built/packed twice with identical bytes. Actual installed sources and publication metadata verified.

Four clean frozen offline compiled installed-package consumers exercise navigation, field, button, typed selects and boolean checkboxes, native validation/entries/reset/disabled behavior, cancellation, EN/ES/themes and teardown/remount. Actual tested five-coordinate archives are retained with their digests.
Angular actual consumer is AOT compiled and uses the official linker for all partial framework libraries, without a JIT fallback.

Core text field passes actual form ownership/submission, default submitter, required/length/custom validation, disabled fieldsets, readonly, reset, explicit restoration callbacks, focus/labels, controlled caret, composition-boundary and invalid-input regression tests. Its actual installed package passes compiled Chromium form journeys.

Angular text field implements ControlValueAccessor and the shared pure Validator: reactive controls, ngModel, nullable/nonnullable reset, dirty/touched and updateOn change/blur/submit pass. Foreign malformed event payloads are rejected before callbacks; validated snapshots survive observer payload mutation.

Fifty production-backed CSF stories and six autodocs pages. Static /ha-ui/ acceptance covers 80 locale/theme/width combinations with passing automatic and independent default-rule axe scans, plus fourteen frame-stable measured HA checkbox states. Both exact HA Roboto fonts are bundled locally.
Storybook found and regressed two shared renderer issues: insufficient light error contrast and partially clipped focused navigation destinations. Both reproduce before their common fixes.

Core button preserves native form validation/submitter/name-value/reset/default Enter using a documented real native auxiliary submitter; state, focus, busy prevention, slots and stale lifecycle/owner guards are exercised in source and actual installed-package consumers. All four button bindings pass source-browser and actual compiled installed-package consumers.

Typed selects preserve numeric/string/boolean model distinctions and frozen multiple selections. Missing, disabled or mode-mismatched values remain explicit and invalid rather than being replaced. Native entries, controlled reset/restoration, disabled fieldsets, external owners, labels, keyboard and all four form bridges pass source and actual installed consumers.

Boolean checkbox has independent app-controlled mixed presentation, one native input and 44px invisible target, strict literal payloads, controlled reset/restoration and all four real framework bindings.

Direct Chrome comparison used a dedicated window/group in the Efra profile, observed entity-table marked/mixed controls and restored selection mode without entity changes. This is agent observation, not owner acceptance of the full UX.

A reproduced stale Enter could submit after a text field or checkbox was disconnected and reattached to the same form. Both now bind deferred Enter to the original connection; a fresh Enter remains accepted.

Measured text-only dashboard tabs match eight original HA light/dark resting/hover/focus/disabled states in both navigation and panel modes. The source campaign adds17 cases; the static gate adds16 comparisons. Read-only decoded-pixel inspection finds zero changed pixels in all16 local samples; this does not claim cross-platform raster or full navigation/app acceptance.

packedContract.scope: Core data, navigation, text field and button; four field and button framework bindings are verified separately; broader controls and application adoption remain required

limitations: Five current families have four real bindings. Dialogs, cards/rows/layout/tokens/status and remaining families/form bridges are still required.
Text-field composition events and restoration callbacks are explicitly exercised; real device IME and automatic browser history restoration remain unverified.
Exact recorded framework pins pass the five implemented families; full cohort support and broader public peer ranges remain unaccepted.
Next.js, Nuxt and SvelteKit explicit server-shell/client fixtures, hydration behavior and other browser engines remain unverified.
All six delivery refinements, accepted-candidate promotion/publication recovery, public Storybook hosting, publisher authority and live publication remain required.
Gateway and Domus adoption, installed deployment/recovery and human UX acceptance remain unverified.
All 64 original baseline cases and six additional delivery cases remain required; no partial increment completes issue #7.
Fresh hosted CI and complete native Bugbot review are required for the source head.

Navigation text-only default-theme samples are calibrated. Icons, overflow affordances, responsive composition and custom font/theme breadth remain required, as do button/field/select visual calibration and full library/app UX acceptance.

reviewRegression.before: 32 C1 cases failed; 78 contract cases passed.
reviewRegression.after: All 138 unit/architecture/CI-contract cases pass; every C1 code point rejected in group labels, item labels and links; visible U+00A0/U+00A1 preserved.

browserEvidence.focusRegression: focus-return-red.log reproduces the stale tab-stop; full green run has no skipped tests.
browserEvidence.initialTestAttempt: Browser cases were authored before the renderer. The first attempted execution could not start because the pinned Chromium binary was absent; no behavioral red result is claimed for that attempt. After runtime provisioning, the first actual run found two fixture/server-boundary issues, recorded in browser-first-execution.log.
browserEvidence.fieldVisualReview: The actual packed dark Spanish field image was inspected; unchanged navigation/framework images match the previously inspected bytes.
browserEvidence.fieldRegression: invalid-edit-red.log reproduced one failure: a malformed synthetic edit left a rejected draft visible. current-coverage.log passes the permanent regression and restores accepted DOM/form state without emitting intent.
browserEvidence.fieldInitialRed: renderer-red.log rejected the missing renderer module before implementation; this is an API-absence red, not a behavioral assertion result.
browserEvidence.frameworkFieldVisualReview: All eight framework field images are represented by three unique byte groups; each unique valid/error dark Spanish image was inspected. Core geometry and semantics remain shared. The current dark error fixture supplies its public semantic error token; a representative new original image is inspected and all four consumers assert the computed color.
browserEvidence.frameworkFieldRed: invalid-event-red.log reproduced four failing adapter cases before the pure payload guard. The final source campaign includes those regressions and observer-mutation cases.
browserEvidence.packedFieldInitialAttempts: packed.log stopped before any browser launch because the local browser path variable was absent. packed-with-runtime.log then exposed a premature React UI-counter assertion; the driver now waits for the observed render state. current-packed.log passes all actual compiled forms; no unsupported behavioral red claim is made for the launch failure.

consumerIsolationRegression.reason: Unlocked offline fixture attempted to resolve Lit through absent ambient registry metadata. Product unit/browser coverage and build passed.
consumerIsolationRegression.localRed: isolated-metadata-red.log reproduces ERR_PNPM_NO_OFFLINE_META with a fresh fixture cache.
consumerIsolationRegression.correction: Derive the exact runtime dependency graph and integrity records from the reviewed workspace lock; bind the actual tarball integrity, use a frozen offline install and assert the fixture lock remains byte-identical.
consumerIsolationRegression.permanentNegativeControl: An independent unlocked fixture must reject with ERR_PNPM_NO_OFFLINE_META against the same empty metadata cache.
consumerIsolationRegression.localGreen: frozen-packed-green.log; strict types, frozen isolated install, DOM-free compilation/import and real packed Chromium journeys pass.

packedFrameworks.scope: Navigation, one controlled text field, native-form buttons, boolean checkboxes and typed single/multiple selects with four framework bindings; other controls, framework SSR and application adoption remain required

packedCohort.scope: Unpublished navigation, text-field, button, checkbox and typed-select preview with four framework bindings; no registry publication or full capability acceptance

frameworkBoundaries.validated: Navigation, one controlled single-line text field, native-form buttons and typed single/multiple selects; remaining controls are still required
frameworkBoundaries.storybook: Implemented catalog/static subpath verified for current families; public Pages deployment and complete-family/human acceptance pending

restoreReviewRegression.problem: The deferred pre-render test assigned a literal expected value without proving restoration intent was observed.
restoreReviewRegression.correction: Capture the restore request before connection, assert its immutable detail and unchanged baseline, then acknowledge its captured value after render; assert no second request. The synchronous acknowledgment case remains.
restoreReviewRegression.validation: 352 source tests pass; coverage remains 100% per authored runtime file and globally. Runtime source/cohort bytes are unchanged.

registrationReviewRegression.problem: Registration tests assumed the dependency-provided customElements shim existed in a Node runtime.
registrationReviewRegression.red: Explicitly removing customElements reproduced two TypeErrors before either registration assertion; two original cases passed.
registrationReviewRegression.correction: Optional registry inspection plus explicit no-registry cases for both tags. Globals restore after every case; both registrations must reject without creating tags.
registrationReviewRegression.validation: 391 source tests pass, including four server registration cases; strict checks and all four runtime coverage metrics remain 100%.

button.visualReview: Original installed Spanish/dark button and narrow light/dark variant/loading representatives inspected. Public accent/on-accent pairs pass axe in all 48 static combinations. No owner HA/human acceptance is inferred.

regressions.implicitClick: Two real Enter cases observed zero native clicks/press requests before correcting the field default-submitter path. A first API-absence red also displayed the Vite import overlay, explaining its unrelated external-label click timeout.
regressions.iconSpacing: Empty icon wrappers added 16 px; the regression failed before using layout-free wrappers.
regressions.busyAndPressed: Two source cases failed on a leaked busy click and missing pressed shape before the common fixes. Cursor/size assertions were authored before their corrections but were not reached in that red run.
regressions.packedResetTiming: The first installed consumer checked the value before the deferred cancelable reset completed. Its actual fixture and original helper are retained; the corrected driver waits for the real Kitchen state instead of writing it or weakening the expected value.
regressions.staticReadiness: The first static campaign waited for only old control families in a button-only story. The driver now asserts readiness and motion on every real control, including buttons.
regressions.formMethodCollisions: Two legal names, requestSubmit and getRootNode, reproduced zero submissions and two native TypeErrors before the field used native prototypes. The corrected 490-test source campaign, strict checks, actual package consumers and static catalog pass; no legal name is forbidden or rewritten.

button.frameworkAPIAbsenceRed: The first source run rejected the missing React Button export before implementation. Vite also reported the not-yet-created Svelte component. This is an API-absence red, not an asserted behavioral failure.
button.frameworkVisualReview: Eight original installed framework button images form two byte-identical groups (light English and dark Spanish). Both unique originals were inspected. No real HA or human app acceptance is inferred.

readonlyReviewRegression.sourceResult: All 34 field source-browser cases pass, including actual readonly submissions for required empty, too short, too long, state-error and custom-error values. Editable mode blocks each invalid value; switching back to readonly submits it without losing form data.
readonlyReviewRegression.initialAttempt: All five new cases initially stopped before submission on an incorrect expectation that ElementInternals.validationMessage becomes empty for readonly controls. Its normative getter retains the stored message. That test expectation was corrected without any renderer change; the complete native submission assertions then passed. The original test and failure log are retained.

select.visualReview: Sixteen original installed-framework images form five byte-identity groups across single/multiple, English/light and Spanish/dark states; one original from every group was inspected. No owner HA or human application acceptance is inferred.

regressions.apiAbsence: Initial policy, renderer and adapter runs rejected missing modules/exports before implementation; no behavioral-red claim is made for those API-absence runs. The first pure test table also failed during naming of a BigInt and spread array rows; rows were explicitly wrapped so the actual arrays reach the policy.
regressions.nativeKeyboard: The initial dropdown-arrow test left both the shared control and a standalone native reference unchanged. A direct Playwright probe observed the same result for native size=1 arrow/Enter/Space combinations, while native typeahead and size=4 arrows worked. Permanent tests verify dropdown typeahead and visible-list arrows. No runtime override was introduced for this platform/driver observation.
regressions.angularValidationPolicy: The first actual Angular consumer recorded empty Saved categories although its current model and later FormData were correct. Its earlier invalid submit was permitted because Angular added novalidate; a UI-counter assertion was premature. A permanent native-submit test observed one invalid submit before the fixture opted into standard ngNativeValidate. The compiled consumer now also asserts noValidate=false and waits for the actual native invalid event before checking blocked submission. Product runtime was unchanged for this fixture correction.
regressions.staticDriver: The first static selector journey searched for f despite the fictional option label Other. The driver now uses o; no component behavior or expected typed value was changed. The static receipt now derives actual story/doc counts from its built index instead of retaining the previous hardcoded counts.

select.nativeFormDataTypes: Standard HTML FormData serializes primitive values as strings; typed property/request models remain distinct. Wire-level type preservation requires JSON models or unique string IDs.

haVisual.scope: Checkbox measured states only; no full SDK or human application UX acceptance

checkbox.visualReview: Original HA and candidate images were inspected; inherited HA font smoothing was corrected. Eight states have identical entire raster pixels; checked/mixed/disabled and the required marker retain small subpixel raster differences. No all-pixel or full-UX equality is claimed. Sixteen installed-framework images form four byte-identity groups.

regressions.staleEnter: Both same-form reconnect tests reproduced a native stale submit before their connection guards. The first field attempt had a missing test import; the corrected tests independently reproduced both submits.
regressions.angularFixture: Its general valueChanges subscription cleared mixed state on validator updates. Mixed state is now changed only by explicit app actions/accepted requests; shared runtime was not responsible for that fixture side effect.
regressions.staticCoordination: Axe audits raced. The driver now waits for the public STORY_FINISHED event, verifies real automatic a11y reports passed, resets default rules and performs its own scan. No automatic audit or rule is disabled.
regressions.prebundling: The new public event import initially caused Vite to reload test frames and invalidate suites. Both browser projects now prebundle their event dependencies; cold source validation passes.
regressions.referenceCapture: Original captures could contain stale frames; the dark wrapper also failed its intended rectangle after cssText concatenation with inherited tokens. Its independent construction and actual rectangle are checked, and captures require at least three originals with two equal consecutive frames. No image editing was used.

navigationVisual.scope: Text-only dashboard controls in the measured default themes; no icons/overflow or full app acceptance.
